episodes.name: Into Fat Air
episodes.overview: The Griffins attempt to conquer Mount Everest after competitive friends mention they plan to scale the legendary peak. Things, however, are not looking up for the Griffins, as a wicked storm leaves them pinned down on the side of the mountain.

episodes.name: Ratings Guy
episodes.overview: Peter gets carried away when the Nielsen people select the Griffins to have their television-viewing habits monitored and he steals a number of the Nielsen boxes in hopes of controlling the airwaves.

episodes.name: The Old Man and the Big 'C'
episodes.overview: When Brian discovers that Carter Pewterschmidt's pharmaceutical company is withholding the cure for cancer from the public in order to gain more profit, he and Stewie plot to expose the big secret that could change the world. Meanwhile, Quagmire reveals a hair-raising secret of his own.

episodes.name: Yug Ylimaf
episodes.overview: Brian abuses Stewie's time machine and causes reality to run in reverse. So the two must work together to set things right before Stewie is "unborn."

episodes.name: Joe's Revenge
episodes.overview: When the criminal who shot Joe years ago, leaving Joe in a wheelchair, becomes a fugitive, Quagmire, Joe and Peter team up to hunt the bad guy down.

episodes.name: Lois Comes Out of Her Shell
episodes.overview: Peter tries to keep up with Lois as she goes through a midlife crisis; Stewie brings home a turtle from the park.

episodes.name: Friends Without Benefits
episodes.overview: When Meg learns her crush is gay and interested in Chris, she uses her brother to get closer to him.

episodes.name: Jesus, Mary and Joseph!
episodes.overview: As the Griffin family is preparing for Christmas, Peter tells his own version of the Nativity story.

episodes.name: Space Cadet
episodes.overview: To boost Chris' self-esteem, Peter and Lois send him to space camp. When camp ends and the Griffins come to pick Chris up, they accidentally are launched into outer space, and it's up to Chris to land the clan safely back on earth.

episodes.name: Brian's Play
episodes.overview: Brian writes a play that becomes a hit in Quahog, but loses his confidence when he finds that the play Stewie wrote is better than his.

episodes.name: The Giggity Wife
episodes.overview: When Peter, Quagmire and Joe visit the Harvard University campus, Quagmire accidentally marries a prostitute. In order to get out of his marriage, Quagmire pretends to be lovers with Peter.

episodes.name: Valentine's Day in Quahog
episodes.overview: On Valentine's Day, Meg goes on a date with a guy she met online, and Lois and Peter stay in bed all day; Brian is visited by his ex-girlfriends.

episodes.name: Chris Cross
episodes.overview: Chris leaves home to move in with Herbert while Stewie and Brian become obsessed with singer Anne Murray.

episodes.name: Call Girl
episodes.overview: When the Griffins find themselves in a financial bind, Lois is forced to find a job of her own. She gets discovered by a "voiceover" talent agent named Randy, who actually runs an adult-only phone line and pays his employees generously. As Lois settles into her new gig, she hears Peter's voice on the other end of the line.

episodes.name: Turban Cowboy
episodes.overview: When Peter, Quagmire and Joe need a jolt in their mundane lives, they decide to go skydiving. But after an unfortunate accident, Peter ends up in the hospital, where he befriends Mahmoud, who convinces Peter to convert to Islam. Quagmire and Joe are suspicious of Mahmoud's intentions and try to stop the friendship from progressing.

episodes.name: 12 and a Half Angry Men
episodes.overview: When Mayor West is put on trial for murder, Brian is the lone holdout voting "not guilty," and he tries to persuade his fellow jurors that there's a reasonable doubt of the Mayor's guilt.

episodes.name: Bigfat
episodes.overview: Peter, Quagmire and Joe take a trip to Canada. But after Peter gets lost for two months, a feral Peter returns to his family with no ability to communicate intelligently.

episodes.name: Total Recall
episodes.overview: After teddy bear Rupert gets recalled, Stewie stops at nothing to get back his beloved best friend. Meanwhile, When Peter falls ill and can't compete in his bowling tournament, Peter becomes jealous when Lois fills in for him.

episodes.name: Save the Clam
episodes.overview: When the owner of The Drunken Clam is killed, Peter and the guys must find a way to save the bar, after the bank threatens to close it. Meanwhile, Meg gets a part-time job at a funeral home.

episodes.name: Farmer Guy
episodes.overview: Peter buys a farm and becomes a meth dealer.

episodes.name: Roads to Vegas
episodes.overview: Duplicates of Brian and Stewie each see a road trip differently.

episodes.name: No Country Club for Old Men
episodes.overview: The Griffins are invited to join the prestigious Barrington Country Club and get thrown out.
